about: Proposed text_blocks.read_aloud overrides for screen and figure blocks: a short spoken description used by narration instead of the block's HTML. Drafted with model help from text_blocks.data.fields and the surrounding prose. Each is pinned to the block's sha256; if the block changes, the override no longer applies. status 'unreviewed' means no person has signed off yet.

overrides.read_aloud: The green circle's screen is all in Dzegoban: two boxes with green checkmarks, {sen hen zi li die fe} one hundred {zo lia kin}, and {man dun li jie hu}. Below them, in bold: {cau tie zen}, {ci fan zi li} four forty-eight.
The motto runs in two short verses: {pa jan li sun zo}, {zai gau fe pa jan}. {go li sun zo}, {bai gau fe go}.

On the screen, a line in English: He took the path less traveled, and that blazed a trail for all. Below it, a poem in Dzegoban: {jan jo san sia}, {ci pa jan li san sia}, {te bia pin hu fe lo shun}, {ci fi mu jan li san sia}, {fe fi mu san sia}, {te shun zo bia pin fe jan}.
